definitions.explanation: The prevention or reduction of sound transmission, or the materials and methods used to achieve this. Commonly used when discussing construction, housing, and music practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{防音|ぼうおん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦しっかりしている→しっかりする：21456_shikkarisuru⟧。
{防音|ぼうおん}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦ピアノ→ピアノ：01376_piano⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{練習|れんしゅう}している→練習する：22991_renshuusuru⟧。
examples.english: I practice piano in a soundproofed room.

examples.japanese: ⟦マンション→マンション：01035_manshon⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}ぶ→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧とき⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{防音|ぼうおん}⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{必|かなら}ず→必ず：01249_kanarazu⟧⟦チェックした→チェックする：04916_chekkusuru⟧⟦ほうがいい→ほうがいい：10078_hougaii⟧。
examples.english: When choosing an apartment, you should always check the soundproofing performance.

notes:
Functions primarily as a noun modifier with ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, forming compounds like {防音|ぼうおん}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (soundproof room). Very practical vocabulary for apartment-hunting in Japan, where noise between units is a common concern.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {防音|ぼうおん}⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (soundproof room)
- {防音|ぼうおん}⟦{壁|かべ}→壁：01290_kabe⟧ (soundproof wall)
- {防音|ぼうおん}⟦{材|ざい}→〜材：28347_zai⟧ (soundproofing material)
- {防音|ぼうおん}⟦{性能|せいのう}→性能：04340_seinou⟧ (soundproofing performance)
- {防音|ぼうおん}⟦{工事|こうじ}→工事：00244_kouji⟧ (soundproofing construction work)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{遮音|しゃおん}→遮音：19182_shaon⟧ — sound blocking (technical; blocking sound transmission)
- ⟦{吸音|きゅうおん}→吸音：19206_kyuuon⟧ — sound absorption (absorbing sound within a room)
